head: DoodleYak drawing app for kids and adults: no ads or in-app purchases
dek: DoodleYak is a 5.99 dollar drawing and painting app for all ages on iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs, with brushes, stamps, mirror drawing and coloring pages. Out since 5 November, it was #25 among paid Graphics and Design apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: Mirror mode copies your lines left to right, top to bottom or in four directions. It comes with 10 backgrounds and 10 coloring pages, and you can import your own picture. It works offline with no account, ads, subscription or in-app purchases, and supports Apple Pencil pressure on iPad. Artwork stays on the device and is moved by hand; it doesn't sync. The maker is Ted Lawson.
where: iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs, 5.99 dollars, out since 5 November
means: If you want a drawing app to hand to a child without ads or purchase buttons, DoodleYak is a one-time price.
todo: Read the listing before buying. Export finished pictures as PNG or save a .doodleyak file if you want to move them to another device.
